meta.title: Qarṭaǧ mbeɛd Qarṭaǧ — seg taneddawt taṛumanit armi d ass-a
meta.desc: Mbeɛd 146 send Ɛisa : Qarṭaǧ taṛumanit, tavandalit d tabyzanṭit, aṭṭef aɛrab, leqrun n ukkes n yizran, tuffra tamaynut, ikecfan akked umḍiq asenfarrutan n wass-a.
hero.title: Qarṭaǧ mbeɛd Qarṭaǧ
hero.lede: Tamdint tapunit tesserɣ deg 146. Ɣef lxrab-is, Qarṭaǧ-nniḍen tedder sebɛa iqrunen, imbeɛd temmut, teqqim d lmεadin n yizran, uqbel ad talel d taddart akked lwert agraɣlan.
hero.alt: Lxrab n lḥamamat n Antonin ɣer rrif n ugaraw n Tunes
hero.caption: Lḥamamat n Antonin, lqern wis 2 — Qarṭaǧ taṛumanit ɣer rrif n ugaraw
stats.0.t: n temdint taṛumanit, tavandalit imbeɛd tabyzanṭit, seg 29 send Ɛisa armi d 698
stats.1.t: n yimukan deg uḥric aṛumani, i deg yeqqim kan uglaḍ
stats.2.t: ajerred n umḍiq asenfarrutan deg lwert agraɣlan n UNESCO
stats.3.t: n yimezdaɣ deg taddart n Qarṭaǧ di uḥsab n 2014
eras.title: Sin ɛecrin iqrunen ɣef yiwet tiɣilt
eras.aside: Yal azemz ibna ɣef win i t-id-yezwaren, neɣ s izran-is.
eras.items.0.title: Qarṭaǧ tettwasers daɣen
eras.items.0.rows.0.v: Caius Gracchus yeɛreḍ ad yesres tanazduɣt, Junonia, qrib umḍiq yettwanεalen ; lmeqsud yemmut yid-s.
eras.items.0.rows.1.v: Yettwaḥudd sɣur César, asers-nni-nniḍen yettwakemmel ddaw n Auguste : Colonia Iulia Concordia Carthago tali-d deg umḍiq-nni n temdint tapunit.
eras.items.0.rows.2.v: Taneddawt n Tafrikt proconsulaire. Tuyat n Byrsa tettwasellel iwakken ad teqbel forum.
eras.items.0.rows.3.v: Mbeɛd times tameqqrant, lḥamamat n Antonin ttwabnant ɣer rrif n lebḥer (Colette Picard).
eras.items.0.rows.4.v: Tettwaneṛ ɣer udin amasiḥi, tamdint tezger uḥeṛṣ tuɣal d yiwet seg yimukan imeqqranen n leɛqal deg ugmur alatini.
eras.items.1.title: Taneddawt n Genséric
eras.items.1.rows.0.v: Ivandaliyen n Genséric ṭṭfen Qarṭaǧ sersen dinna lkersi n tgelda-nsen.
eras.items.1.rows.1.v: Seg Qarṭaǧ i tεedda lebḥer tavandalit i yeḥuddun Ṛuma.
eras.items.1.rows.2.v: Ariens, igelliden ivandaliyen ṭṭfen Taglisya Takatulikit n Tafrikt : lemqedmin ttwaɣerben, tiglisiyin ttwakksent.
eras.items.2.title: Tuɣalin n Tagelda
eras.items.2.rows.0.v: Bélisaire, anezwi n Justinien, yeṭṭef daɣen tamdint, i d-yuɣalen d taneddawt yesεan ssɛaya d lkersi n tnmahla n Tafrikt.
eras.items.2.rows.1.v: Tafrikt tabyzanṭit tettwafka i yiwen uḥekkam, d udmasan d uɛesskari, yezzun di Qarṭaǧ.
eras.items.2.rows.2.v: Héraclius, mmi-s n uḥekkam n Qarṭaǧ, yeddu ɣer Constantinople, yeṭṭef lkersi, yesres dinna tagelda.
eras.items.3.title: Tunes teqbel lqiyada
eras.items.3.rows.0.v: Hassan Ibn Numan yeṭṭef tamdint (Grimal). Tettwahelki tettwasserɣ, imezdaɣ-is ɛeddan ɣer Tunes.
eras.items.3.rows.1.v: Tunes tuɣal d tamdint tagejdant, ad tefk isem-is i tmurt ; isem n Africa, yuɣalen d Ifriqiya, ad yili isem n umurig meṛṛa.
eras.items.3.rows.2.v: Mbeɛd azal n sin iqrunen n lxlawi, amḍiq yebda tikkelt-nniḍen yettwazdeɣ deg zzman n Ifatimiyen, akken i d-yeqqar Gibbon.
eras.items.4.title: Lmεadin n lmermer
eras.items.4.rows.0.v: Tigejdal, iqerra d telwaḥin n lmermer țwakksent iwakken ad bennun lǥwameɛ, ixxamen n ssulṭan akked tiglisiyin : di Kairouan, di Tunes, armi d Turuft.
eras.items.4.rows.1.v: Saint Louis yers ɣer Qarṭaǧ deg tiεmert tis tmanya, yemmut s lehlak zdat Tunes. Lexsas n teklal-agi isekkeṛ zzman n tiεmaṛ.
eras.items.4.rows.2.v: Taddart n zzman-nni — lǥameɛ, aɣerbaz, azal n ɛecrin n lxiwanat akked azal n 500 n ifellaḥen — tehlek sɣur leɛsakar iṣpanyawen n La Goulette, i d-yesres Charles Quint.
eras.items.4.rows.3.v: Sin iɣerman kan n tfellaḥt ṭṭfen taneddawt taqdimt : Douar Chott akked La Malga.
eras.items.5.title: Asteεfu, taglisya tameqqrant akked ikecfan
eras.items.5.rows.0.v: Lbay yefka i Fransa lqaɛa ɣef Byrsa. Louis-Philippe yazen amesnilem ad yettnadi amḍiq n tmettant n Saint Louis : mi ur t-yufi ara, yeṭṭef amḍiq ihlan akteṛ n tamawalt, anida tettwabna tnezlit.
eras.items.5.rows.1.v: Imeqqranen n lbaylek ggen deg-s amḍiq-nsen n unebdu : axxam n Mustapha Khaznadar di Salammbô, axxam Zarrouk, axxam n Mustapha Ben Ismaïl (Revault).
eras.items.5.rows.2.v: Ddaw n uḥekkam afransis, taglisya n Saint-Louis teɣreḏ Byrsa ; tuɣal d tagejdant n Tafrikt i lkardinal Lavigerie.
eras.items.5.rows.3.v: Lameṛ n lbaylek n 15 yunyu yesres taddart n Qarṭaǧ.
eras.items.5.rows.4.v: Le Corbusier yebna axxam n Baizeau, d lxedma-ines kan di Tunisia.
eras.items.6.title: Taddart d lwert agraɣlan
eras.items.6.rows.0.v: Bourguiba yextar axxam n zzman uḥekkam, ɣer rrif n lebḥer, iwakken ad yili d axxam alḥakimi.
eras.items.6.rows.1.v: Zdat n uɣerbaz, UNESCO tezzi teklal tagraɣlant tameqqrant iwakken ad tsellek Qarṭaǧ.
eras.items.6.rows.2.v: Amḍiq asenfarrutan yettwajerred deg lwert agraɣlan.
eras.items.6.rows.3.v: Ineddawen n Ṛuma akked Qarṭaǧ, Ugo Vetere akked Chedli Klibi, gran lemɛahda n talwit n lemtel i yesekkṛen amenɣi apunik wis krad.
eras.items.6.rows.4.v: Asekkeṛ n lǥameɛ Mâlik ibn Anas ɣef tiɣilt n Odéon.
chr.title: Qarṭaǧ tamasiḥit
chr.intro: Taneddawt n Tafrikt taṛumanit, Qarṭaǧ tuɣal d yiwet seg imukan n udin amasiḥi alatini : imeskaren-is bennun tutlayt n tẓuri n ddin n ugmur, lemqedmin-is sedduklen aṭas n tjemaɛin.
chr.councils.0.v: Tajmaɛt n Qarṭaǧ tesres tabdart n yidlisen n Linǥil i tqeblen Taglisya n Tafrikt.
chr.councils.1.v: Lmeɛraḍa n Qarṭaǧ tesdukkel ugar n 500 n lemqedmin ikatulikiyen d yidonatistiyen ; amendac aɣelnaw Marcellinus yenkar adonatisme.
chr.councils.2.v: Agellid avandali Hunéric yessawel lemqedmin ikatulikiyen d yiariens : amagar yeldi aḥeṛṣ amaynut.
chr.people.0.name: Tertullien
chr.people.0.text: Yilul-d di Qarṭaǧ, ameskar amasiḥi amezwaru ameqqran s tutlayt talatinit. Adlis-ines Apologétique yeẓẓuɣuṛ ɣef imasiḥiyen zdat tuccḍiwin n wat ccirk.
chr.people.1.name: Perpétue akked Félicité
chr.people.1.text: Taqcict tanaẓurt akked wakli-s, ttwaεnaqent deg uḥric n Qarṭaǧ. Taqsist n lmihanat-nsent teqbel tajrida n Perpétue.
chr.people.2.name: Cyprien
chr.people.2.text: Lmeqdem n Qarṭaǧ azal n 249, yezgi Taglisya-ines deg uḥeṛṣ n Dèce, imbeɛd aqerru-s yettwagzem ddaw n Valérien.
chr.people.3.name: Augustin
chr.people.3.text: Yilul-d di Thagaste, yeɣra imbeɛd yesselmed tiẓuri n wawal di Qarṭaǧ. Lmeqdem n Hippone, yettuɣal-d dinna aṭas iwakken ad yesselmed ad yeqqim deg tjemaɛin.
surv.title: Ayen i yeqqimen ddren seg Ṛuma
surv.aside: Tutlayt tapunit, sufeṭ d yiyilluten yettwasemman : wali daɣen
surv.items.0.title: Opus africanum
surv.items.0.text: Lesswar-agi s izran ibeddan, i yellan yakan di Kerkouane, yettwaf deg zzman aṛumani armi d Capitole n Dougga.
surv.items.1.title: Imsenεalen n lmuzayik ifrikiyen
surv.items.1.text: S lmermer yelhan, lxiwanat n Tafrikt sfeṛqen deg Tagelda meṛṛa lḥiwanat-nsen akked tḥilat n yiyilluten.
surv.items.2.title: Imukan iqeddsen inupuniyen
surv.items.2.text: Thinissut, Bou Kornine, El Hofra qrib Cirta, izran « n Ghorfa » : Saturne afrikan, yewrit seg Baal, mazal-it yettwaqdar armi d tazwart n lqern wis 4 (Lancel).
surv.items.3.title: Sufeṭ, kra n tikwal krad
surv.items.3.text: Timdinin tiṛumaniyin n Tafrikt mazal-itent ferrnent sufeṭ deg lqern wis 2 ; kra n tikwal krad, ayen i ttwalin kra n yimusnawen n tsamiyin d ayen i d-yekkan seg Imaziɣen (Lipinski).
surv.items.4.title: Texxamin n tira tipuniyin
surv.items.4.text: Ttunefkent i igelliden inumidiyen deg 146, ɛawanen ahat Salluste i wedlis-ines Amenɣi n Jugurtha ; tamsalt mazal-itt tettwasmeyya, deg zzman n Augustin ur qqimen ala d asmekti.
surv.items.5.title: Agaraw ɣer taɛrabt ?
surv.items.5.text: I Stéphane Gsell, imbeɛd M'hamed Hassine Fantar, tudert iɣezzifen n tutlayt tasamit tezmer ad tefk afus i taɛrabt n Lmaɣrib.
dig.title: Anwa i yekcafen Qarṭaǧ ?
dig.rows.0.v: akunsul n Danemark yesres aɣawas amezwaru yelhan n lxrab.
dig.rows.1.v: yettnadi deg tiɣilt n Byrsa akked lebḥura, yettnadi ɣef temdint tapunit.
dig.rows.2.v: Lmeqdem-agi amellal yekcef deg waṭas n iseggasen imḍalen ipuniyen d tiglisiyin ; lxiwanat-is d aẓaṛ n usinag agraɣlan n Qarṭaǧ.
dig.rows.3.v: anemhal n ssuq n lqdima n Lbaylek, yesnirem s telqey imḍalen ipuniyen.
dig.rows.4.v: tafrat n umḍiq aqeddas n Salammbô, yettwakecfen deg iseggasen i d-yeddan.
dig.rows.5.v: M'hamed Hassine Fantar, Abdelmajid Ennabli, Azedine Beschaouch… i yesneflεen ṛṛay ɣef uḥudu i yesεa uɣerbaz ɣef umḍiq.
dig.rows.6.v: teklal tagraɣlant n UNESCO : Ialmaniyen (F. Rakob, lḥiḍ n lqern wis 5 send Ɛisa akked ugraw n rrif n lebḥer), Imirikaniyen (L. Stager, tofet akked lebḥer n ttjara), Ibritaniyen (H. Hurst, tigzirt n Amirauté), Ifransisen (S. Lancel, agraw apuni n Byrsa)…
redisc.title: Qarṭaǧ tettwasnulfa daɣen
redisc.alt: Didun tebna Qarṭaǧ, tugna n Turner
redisc.caption: Turner, Didun tebna Qarṭaǧ, 1815 — National Gallery, Londres
redisc.points.0: Lqern wis 17 : Geographia sacra n Samuel Bochart yettḥewwis ɣef tiddi n Ifiniqiyen ; deg lqern wis 18, azru n Nora, di Sardaigne, yesnerna leεqel n yimusnawen.
redisc.points.1: 1817 : Turner yesken Aɣelli n tgelda taqarṭaǧit, iqabel tugna-ines n Didun ; ad yefk tnac n tugniwin timeqqranin i tɣawsa-agi.
redisc.points.2: 1920 : Stéphane Gsell yeḥkem s teqsiḥ ɣef taẓwaṛt taqarṭaǧit ; tasenfarrut n lqern wis 20 wis sin tesmid aṭas lḥakem-agi (Lancel).
redisc.points.3: Bourguiba yegg seg tgellidt n tasersayt d lemtel n usli aɣelnaw ; tisuɣyin timeqqranin (axxam n Grassi 1988, Asinag n umaḏal aɛrab 2007-2008) sfeṛqen Qarṭaǧ.
site.title: Amḍiq asenfarrutan ass-a
site.aside: Lxrab s telqey aṛumani, s tegzirin tipuniyen, feṛqen deg taddart n yezdeɣ.
site.cards.0.name: Lḥamamat n Antonin
site.cards.0.text: Ttwabnant ger 145 d 162, mbeɛd times tameqqrant, gar wid imeqqranen akteṛ n Tagelda taṛumanit. Ddaw-agi kan, win n texxamin n lxedma, i yeqqimen (Ennabli d Slim).
site.cards.1.name: Tiɣilt n Byrsa
site.cards.1.alt: Agraw apuni n tiɣilt n Byrsa
site.cards.1.text: Ddaw n forum aṛumani, agraw n ixxamen n tazwart n lqern wis 2 send Ɛisa : lmaɣaza ɣef webrid, lǥab ddaw n wakal, abrid ɣer ammas (Lipinski). Ɣef tuyat, asinag agraɣlan akked Acropolium, taglisya taqdimt.
site.cards.2.name: Lebḥura ipuniyen
site.cards.2.text: Sin ilmayen ḥeznen talɣa n yigelmimen : lebḥer n ttjara d lebḥer n umenɣi azir s tigzirt-is n Amirauté (Stager, Hurst).
site.cards.3.name: Tofet
site.cards.3.text: Amḍiq iqeddsen n Tanit akked Baal Hammon. Tiktit n yisfal n warraw, aṭas lweqt tettwaqbel, tettwasmeyya sɣur imusnawen am Sabatino Moscati.
site.cards.4.name: Lγaba n ixxamen iṛumaniyen
site.cards.4.alt: Lmuzayik n Dominus Julius, yettwafen di Qarṭaǧ (asinag n Bardo)
site.cards.4.text: Qrib ṭṭiyaṭru, « axxam n yiɣerdayen » yesεa isem-is seg lmuzayik-ines. Lmuzayikat timeqqranin n Qarṭaǧ, am tin n Dominus Julius, llant deg usinag n Bardo.
site.minor.0.name: Ṭṭiyaṭru
site.minor.0.text: Yettwasnulfa i azal n 5000 n yimeẓri, ur yeqqim ara d acemma siwa lxrab deg tazwart n lqern wis 20 ; yettwasnefles aṭas, yeṭṭef Tesuɣit Tagraɣlant n Qarṭaǧ.
site.minor.1.name: Uḥric
site.minor.1.text: Uglaḍ kan i yeḥuzen ugar n lef iseggasen n ukkes n yizran. Perpétue akked Félicité ttwaεnaqent dinna deg 203.
site.minor.2.name: Lmidan
site.minor.2.text: Ur d-yeqqim ala laglaḍ aɣezfan deg tferkit.
site.minor.3.name: Lǥab
site.minor.3.text: Lǥab imeqqranen aṛumaniyen deg tagara n uqeddu n Zaghouan. Qrib aṭas, uẓekka n yixeddamen n uprokunsul (Le Bohec).
site.visit: Aɣelluy ameqqran d asefraq : lxrab gent tigzirin deg wammas n ixxamen d yiferkiwen. TGM, i yezgren taddart (ssitatat n Salammbô, Byrsa, Dermech, Hanibal…), yesselha seg umḍiq ɣer wayeḍ.
related.0.title: Aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ
related.0.text: Aḥeṛṣ, aɣelli n Byrsa, akked tmacahut n lmelḥ.
related.1.title: Ɣef yiḍaren n Qarṭaǧ
related.1.text: Seg Kerkouane armi d Carthagène, imukan ara tzurem.
